meta.note: Powered German probe, 48 items. Same cells and same carrier as data/tasks_time_de.json, with the into_hour cell grown from 5 items to 15 and the regional cell from 2 to 12, because five items could not separate any two models. Kept as a separate file because the first run happened before the scale hypothesis existed, and merging would test that hypothesis partly on the data that suggested it; see F57 for the pre-registration. No clock time here repeats one from the first probe and none is a few-shot demonstration. German counts INTO the coming hour with a closed set of three items (halb, viertel, dreiviertel) and has no productive counting-into form, so from_hour items can only be N nach X. The twelve regional items are flagged de_regional: viertel N and dreiviertel N are used in the east and south, their gold label is contested among native speakers, and they must be excluded from any primary comparison unless deliberately included. viertel is lowercase throughout on purpose so the minimal pair differs by one word and not also by capitalisation. WORDING NOT YET CHECKED BY A NATIVE SPEAKER — see tools/make_german_probe2.py.
